mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.product_id, f.create_time, p.title AS productTitle, p.cover_image AS productCover, p.price AS productPrice, p.status AS productStatus FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
